title: Science PCM
intro: Physics, Chemistry and Maths after Class 10. Pick a career to see its route.

nodes.label: Choose PCM
nodes.note: Take Standard Maths in Class 10 if you are unsure. Computer Science or Biology can be the optional subject.

nodes.label: Boards and entrance prep
nodes.note: In Karnataka this is the 2-year PUC. KCET rank uses 50% of PUC marks.

nodes.label: BE / BTech
nodes.note: 4 years. Computer science, electronics, mechanical, civil, aerospace and more.

nodes.label: B.Arch
nodes.note: 5 years. Through NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A.

nodes.label: NDA training and degree
nodes.note: Officer training with a degree, then commission.

nodes.label: Engineer
nodes.note: Software, core engineering, aerospace, data and AI roles.

nodes.label: Architect
nodes.note: Registration with the Council of Architecture.

nodes.label: Defence officer
nodes.note: Army, Navy or Air Force officer.

nodes.label: Scientist
nodes.note: Physics, chemistry, maths and research careers.
